headline: Executive order signed in October 2020 addressing how federal agencies manage US water resources and water infrastructure.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to update how it manages the nation's water resources and water systems. No summary was provided, so its specific requirements, programs, and deadlines are not described here.
